in_marathi.name: Janaki
in_marathi.long_meaning: Janaki हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Janaki is a Sanskrit name derived from the term 'Janani', meaning 'mother'. In Hindu mythology, Janaki is the name of Sita, the wife of Lord Rama.
